info.title: Galaxy of Beauty API (tRPC)
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the tRPC API. Generated from the appRouter — one path per procedure with its zod input schema; the batch envelope {"0":{"json":…}} is the wire format the web and mobile clients send.

post.description: tRPC procedure. POST with the batch envelope — body `{"0":{"json":<input>}}`; responses arrive as `[{"result":{"data":…}}]` or `[{"error":{…}}]`.
